replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello Eteh,

This player isn't using no slow down. However this user could be using another modification called autoblock. Based on the evidence you have provided i cannot tell if he is hacking or if it is possibly a graphical glitch. If you have any more evidence of this player then please upload it and post it so we can determine if he is hacking or if it is just a visual glitch.

Regards,
Posighdun - Avicus Moderator
